description: This file contains a Python module implementing a heuristic subtitle alignment utility. It provides functions to realign subtitle cues to a reference transcript by tokenizing, matching via dynamic spans, and adjusting timing while enforcing temporal constraints. The main function `align_subtitles_to_transcript` is designed for direct use, with helper functions for normalization, span matching, and timing adjustments. It does not depend on external libraries beyond standard Python modules.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(s: str)
methods.description: Lowercases, strips punctuation except apostrophes, and squeezes whitespace in a string for robust token matching.

methods.name: List[str] _tokens(s: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes a normalized string into a list of words.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Computes Jaccard similarity between two token lists.

methods.name: float _safe_float(v, default=0.0)
methods.description: Converts a value to float, with a default fallback on error.

methods.name: List[Dict] _sort_by_start(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Sorts a list of subtitle or transcript items by their 'start' time, coercing non-dicts.

methods.name: float _duration(item: Dict)
methods.description: Calculates duration of a subtitle or transcript segment.

methods.name: str _merge_texts(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Concatenates texts from a list of items into a single string.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _span_time(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of a list of transcript segments.

methods.name: float _clip(val: float, lo: float, hi: float)
methods.description: Clamps a float value between lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: List[Dict] _enforce_monotonic_nonoverlap(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_dur: float = 0.2)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitles to ensure non-decreasing start times and minimal gaps and durations.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,float] _best_transcript_span_for_sub( sub_tokens: List[str], transcript: List[Dict], start_idx: int, max_span: int = 5, min_sim: float = 0.2, )
methods.description: Finds the best contiguous transcript span matching a subtitle based on Jaccard similarity.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _distribute_time_within_span( sub_text: str, span_text: str, span_start: float, span_end: float )
methods.description: Estimates subtitle start/end times proportionally within a matched transcript span.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles_to_transcript( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, max_span: int = 5, min_similarity: float = 0.2, min_duration: float = 0.4, min_gap: float = 0.02, )
methods.description: Main function to align subtitle timings to a reference transcript using token overlap and greedy span matching, enforcing temporal constraints.
